### T-763 — Carry instructions, the command switch and a native suspension through a session

> _2026-11-23 · core/blong · open_

Planned in [#300](https://github.com/feasibleone/blong/issues/300).

`IAgentSessionRequest` gains `instructions`, `allowShell` and `toolDispatch` (method name, ticket
and session ids, channel); `IAgentSessionResult` gains `suspended: {promptId?: string}`. Each field
is optional so `deepseek`, `vercel`, `mastra` and `sim` compile unchanged.

### T-649 — Add the blob reference contract to `core/blong`

> _2026-11-14 · core/blong · done_

Planned in [#261](https://github.com/feasibleone/blong/issues/261).

A new `core/blong/blob.ts` exporting `IBlobMeta`, `blobUriParse('blob://party/<key>')`,
`blobUriFormat`, and `blobScopeMatch(meta, scopes)`, with the `anonymous` and `authenticated` tokens
as constants (`BLOB_SCOPE_ANONYMOUS`, `BLOB_SCOPE_AUTHENTICATED`). Both the server realm and the
browser widget import this file, which is why it is here rather than in the realm (@@D-842).
`IBlobMeta` is the shape the store persists, field for field.

- verify: `blong-dev test --files core/blong/blob.test.ts` covers a URI round trip, a malformed URI,
  `any`/`all` matching, and an anonymous blob matching an empty scope list.

core/blong/blob.ts with IBlobMeta, URI parse/format and scope matching, re-exported from types.ts;
26 tap assertions, full coverage, package lints

### T-714 — Re-export the signal and error types from `core/blong/types.ts`

> _2026-11-18 · core/blong · done_

Planned in [#277](https://github.com/feasibleone/blong/issues/277).

Make `ITypedError`, the declared-vocabulary types and the signal method type come from
`@feasibleone/lukaot`, keeping the names every realm imports. `IErrorFactory` stays the framework's

- verify: `cd core/blong && blong-dev test && blong-dev lint` passes, and a grep shows no lukaot
